displayPattern: Dishwasher display shows AE (also shown as EI or FE on some models)
meaning: Leakage or overfilling error: the water supply exceeded the standard amount or a leak was detected. The dishwasher keeps draining to protect the floor.
causes: Unit not level or door not aligned
Water poured into the Heat Dry blower
diySteps: Load big plates and pots upside down
Use detergent made for dishwashers, not dishwashing liquid
If no water is leaking onto the floor but the error shows, unplug the dishwasher (use the switch or power strip that controls it) and request service
Do not pull out a built-in unit if you poured water into the Heat Dry blower; request service instead
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the unit is not level, or AE persists on a level unit, LG says to request service.
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
